## Documentation Issue
A clear and concise description of the documentation issue.

## Location
Where is the issue located?
- File: [e.g., README.md, docs/INSTALLATION.md]
- Section: [e.g., Installation section, Troubleshooting]

## Issue Description
Describe the documentation issue:
- [ ] Typo or grammar error
- [ ] Outdated information
- [ ] Missing information
- [ ] Unclear explanation
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Other

## Suggested Fix
If you have a suggestion for how to fix the issue, please describe it here.

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the documentation issue.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for existing documentation issues
- [ ] I have provided the file location
- [ ] I have described the issue clearly
- [ ] I have suggested a fix (if applicable)
